$comment: AndroidX Wear samples this catalog cannot render, each with the reason and the evidence. A declared, CHECKED gap -- re-running the import and the render without an entry is what says whether it is still needed. Entries come from a real failure, never from a guess ahead of one. Two units, because there are two failure modes. `samples` lists FILES that do not COMPILE; it is the unit scripts/import-samples.mjs copies, so a listed file takes its whole sample set out of the catalog -- prefer a patch wherever one is small enough to state. `previews` lists individual SAMPLES that compile but cannot RUN here; scripts/samples-previews.mjs generates no @Preview wrapper for them, which keeps the rest of their file in the catalog.

previews.reason: Calls rememberAmbientModeManager(), whose AmbientModeManagerImpl constructor touches com.google.wear.services.ambient.AmbientComponentState -- a Wear OS SYSTEM api that upstream itself compiles against as compileOnly and that ships only in a watch's system image. There is no artifact to add: com.google.wear:wear-sdk and com.google.android.wearable:wear-sdk both 404 on Google Maven, and no wear-sdk.jar exists under any Android SDK platform. Ambient mode is also a state no still frame can show. The other 8 samples in OneHandedGestureSamples.kt render, so this is a per-sample skip rather than a file quarantine.
